attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Image1 is the exact original game character portrait/card and sole source authority. Image2 is the user yellow mascot identity reference. Produce one independent full-resolution yellow mascot fusion preserving original composition and aspect ratio.
Actually viewed source-specific features: Small tilted photograph card with one cream note overlapping the right side. Exact small card shows a stern clean-shaven man in dark navy peaked service cap with gold bird badge, gold front embroidery/braid and black visor; short gray-brown side hair partly visible, no spectacles or beard, dark navy uniform with gold shoulder/visible chest detail, pale-gray shirt layer and black/white cross neck decoration. Preserve actual three-quarter face/gaze, narrow serious lips, tilted gray frame, opaque gray backing and one cream overlapping right note with two compact upper rows. Retain only the actual visible hair and smooth clean-shaven upper lip/chin; cap shadows are not a beard. Keep exact head angle/crop and the cross decoration as in this small original, not an assumed same-name larger variant.
Convert the visible character anatomy to a smooth golden-yellow compact round mascot with green-ringed black eyes, retaining original hair/fur contour, brows and only actual source facial hair with exact extent, density and colour. Preserve all real accessories, headgear, clothing details, source head direction, gaze, pose, lighting and crop. Do not infer appearance from filename or biography. No human skin/nose/ears, new beard, hat, people, symbols or decorations.
Match the actual source mouth and expression: a somber downturned mouth remains visibly downturned, a small lip parting remains slightly open, and an open toothy or happy mouth remains open. Do not replace every mouth with the neutral grey reference wedge or an upward smile. Retain subtle asymmetry and brow mood.
Use a compact round head with curved chin resting immediately at the source neckline through a VERY SHORT BROAD transition. Fit existing garment collar and shoulder lines to the mascot, preserving original open/closed fastening. No long yellow stalk, neck roll, pinched ring, floating collar, clipping or cream neck bib. Preserve actual bare/animal clothing state; do not invent a human garment where absent.
Standalone source retains its COMPLETE original painted rectangular backdrop and all original subject/clothing through every edge, fully opaque. Only an original framed card retains that exact tilted frame, wholly opaque backing, cream overlapping note and genuine alpha outside the complete card silhouette. Keep original upper-note multirow markings in their actual position/footprint/contrast as indistinct dark strokes; never erase them into blank parchment, add extra writing or invent readable words/numbers. All original solid surfaces stay fully opaque. Keep full painterly detail and tool output resolution. One asset, no comparison board, new label, text or watermark.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original photograph FRAME AND NOTE silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual tilted photo rectangle, frame rim and overlapping note intact. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.

EDIT ONLY THE PERSON in image 1. Image 1 is the exact original game portrait/card and the sole authority for visible features, composition, clothing and exterior. Image 2 is only the user mascot identity reference: a fictional yellow 奶龙 with a compact round head, short broad neck, solid black oval eyes with green rings and no white sclera, one small mouth at the actual original mouth position, and no human nose, ears or skin. If a moustache is present, the one mouth remains below it; never add a second gray slit or default mascot lip above the moustache.

SOURCE-VISIBLE FEATURES TO PRESERVE:
Dark navy peaked cap with gold front insignia and gold oakleaf-style visor decoration; graying hair at the temples, pale eyebrows, a smooth chin and no visible moustache or beard. Dark navy uniform with one prominent gold shoulder board on the viewer-left shoulder, white shirt, dark tie and small pale collar decorations.
Retain the actual source hair, eyebrows, facial-hair extent, headgear, eyewear, clothing and decorations only where visibly present. Source-visible eyebrows must remain distinct painted hair, never a bare yellow forehead. Do not copy a bare scalp or missing eyebrows from the mascot reference over real source hair. Do not invent features from names or biographies.

COMPOSITION, EXPRESSION AND LIGHT:
Preserve the near-frontal head and shoulders, direct gaze, friendly broad smile with a slightly open mouth, chest-up photographic crop, and bright frontal facial light moderated by the cap-brim shadow.
Fit the existing collar naturally around a rounded chin and very short broad neck transition while preserving its original open/closed state. The rounded chin must sit close to the neckline; never extend a long yellow funnel through an open collar. No long neck column, pinched collar, floating cloth, clipping or cream bib. Preserve exactly one source-appropriate mouth and expression.

BACKGROUND, FRAME AND EXTERIOR:
Preserve the entire real tilted dark frame and overlapping warm-cream note, including its existing faint gray upper marks, mostly blank lower paper and small dark right-edge tab. The muted gray-olive photographic backplate inside the frame is opaque; lock its color, brightness and subtle mottled texture Return genuine transparency only outside the complete original bust or complete card/frame/note silhouette. No working matte, halo, smoke or invented backdrop may remain. Keep every subject, garment, photographic backing, frame and note interior fully opaque.

NATIVE TRANSPARENT EXTERIOR PASS AND EVIDENCE LIMITS:
Return a native RGBA with actual transparency outside the complete silhouette, never a white, gray or colored working-matte halo. Do not paint a checkerboard or green screen. Any deterministic source-alpha mapping is a separate later decision requiring actual silhouette and visual review, not an automatic step. At 65x67, the exact cap and collar insignia shapes are too small to read; retain their visible metallic colors and placement without adding symbols. Do not invent readable writing, extra note rows, symbols, people or comparison panels. Keep full returned detail and the source composition; no watermark.
